s: Hi everyone, and welcome to Word Kitchen.
I am Maya, and this is Lena.
Today we are talking about a beautiful topic: family.
Let us start with the word mother.
Maya, tell me about your mother.
My mother is the best cook in the world.
My mother makes a big dinner every Sunday.
My mother invites our whole family.
I help my mother in the kitchen, and my mother always smiles.
My mother calls me every day.
I love my mother very much.
Now let us talk about father.
My father and I watch football together.
My father makes the best breakfast on Saturday.
My father sings in the car, and my father and I sing together.
My sister is older than me.
My sister and I go to the park together.
My sister is my best friend.
My sister helps me with my work.
My sister calls me every night.
My brother teaches me new songs.
My brother is younger than me, but my brother is very smart.
I have no brother, but I want a brother.
A brother is a good friend for life.
Family also means son and daughter.
Tell me about your son and your daughter.
I have a son and a daughter.
My son is seven years old.
My son plays with his toy cars every day.
My daughter is five years old.
My son and my daughter play together.
Your son and daughter sound so sweet.
The baby is one year old.
The baby laughs at my son.
My son sings to the baby.
My daughter gives the baby toys.
The baby is the smallest in our family.
I visit my grandmother every week.
My grandmother loves my sister and my brother.
My grandfather worked on a farm.
My grandfather shows me old photos.
My grandfather plays with my son and my daughter.
My cousin lives in another city.
My cousin and I swim together.
My cousin is like a brother to me.
My cousin is my best friend too.
My cousin calls me every night.
My cousin and my sister are good friends.
Tell us about your mother, your father, your sister, your brother, your son, your daughter, your baby, your grandmother, your grandfather, and your cousin.
Practice these ten words with your family today.
See you next time on Word Kitchen.
